subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw add per-user token and cost accounting, and if so what canonical user or billing identity, retention policy, and UI/API authorization model should it use?
rationale: The requested feature spans stable Gateway usage APIs, Control UI, slash-command output, and sensitive user attribution data, so the permanent identity and privacy contract cannot be chosen safely by automation.

options.title: Design core attribution first
options.body: Define the billing principal, retention, redaction, and operator-read access rules before extending `sessions.usage` and the dashboard.

options.title: Defer to plugin/API discussion
options.body: Keep core per-user billing out until a plugin or analytics API can consume privacy-safe usage events without new core policy.

options.title: Decline raw user accounting
options.body: Preserve existing session, agent, channel, provider, and model usage surfaces while explicitly rejecting raw user ID usage logs.

recommendation.title: Design core attribution first
recommendation.body: Define the billing principal, retention, redaction, and operator-read access rules before extending `sessions.usage` and the dashboard.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent usage docs, shared usage helper, and Control UI billing work make this the best available product/API owner signal.
